art_instructions: Draw a cozy woodland schoolroom from a medium shot at eye level. The owl, Glaux, is perched on a small wooden desk, sitting upright with her amber eyes focused gently ahead. Her tiny green scarf is neatly tied, and her small satchel rests beside her feet. The desk has a smooth wooden surface and is positioned near other desks arranged in a semicircle, each with tiny cushions. The walls are made of warm brown wood with painted yellow trim, and a large chalkboard hangs at the front. Soft green grass is visible through wide windows with flower boxes. A small alphabet rug is centered on the floor. Glaux looks alert and engaged, embodying a calm, focused classroom presence. There are no other characters in the room; the setting is quiet and conducive to learning.
